notes: หนังสือเดินทาง is the formal and official term, but Thais very commonly use the loanword 'พาสปอร์ต' (passport) in everyday conversation.

senses.definition: An official document issued by a government certifying the holder's identity and citizenship, entitling them to travel under its protection to and from foreign countries.
